annotations.text: Thunderbird's menus API is similar to the Firefox menus API, but has been adapted to better suit Thunderbird's specific needs.

description: The menus API allows to add items to Thunderbird's menus. You can choose what types of objects your context menu additions apply to, such as images, hyperlinks, and pages.

events.description: Fired when a context menu item is clicked. This is a user input event handler. For asynchronous listeners some restrictions apply.
events.name: onClicked

parameters.description: Information about the item clicked and the context where the click happened.
parameters.name: info

parameters.description: The details of the tab where the click took place. If the click did not take place in a tab, this parameter will be missing.
parameters.name: tab

events.description: Fired when a menu is shown. The extension can add, modify or remove menu items and call $(ref:menus.refresh) to update the menu.
events.name: onShown

parameters.description: Information about the context of the menu action and the created menu items.
parameters.name: info

parameters.description: The details of the tab where the menu was opened.
parameters.name: tab

events.description: Fired when a menu is hidden. This event is only fired if onShown has fired before.
events.name: onHidden

functions.description: Creates a new context menu item. Note that if an error occurs during creation, you may not find out until the creation callback fires (the details will be in runtime.lastError).
functions.name: create

checked.description: The initial state of a checkbox or radio item: <var>true</var> for selected and <var>false</var> for unselected. Only one radio item can be selected at a time in a given group of radio items.

annotations.description: This is an enum which was added in Thunderbird 124 to explicitly spell out built-in commands, but as they are just strings they have been supported since Thunderbird 66.

command.description: Specifies a command to issue for the context click. Can either be a user defined command, or one of the predefined action commands.

contexts.description: List of contexts this menu item will appear in. Defaults to <var>['page']</var> if not specified.

documentUrlPatterns.description: Lets you restrict the item to apply only to documents whose URL matches one of the given patterns. (This applies to frames as well.) For details on the format of a pattern, see Match Patterns.

enabled.description: Whether this context menu item is enabled or disabled. Defaults to true.

icons.description: Custom icons to display next to the menu item. Custom icons can only be set for items appearing in submenus.

id.description: The unique ID to assign to this item. Mandatory for event pages. Cannot be the same as another ID for this extension.

onclick.description: A function that will be called back when the menu item is clicked. Event pages cannot use this.

parameters.description: Information about the item clicked and the context where the click happened.
parameters.name: info

parameters.description: The details of the tab where the click took place.
parameters.name: tab

parentId.description: The ID of a parent menu item; this makes the item a child of a previously added item.

targetUrlPatterns.description: Similar to documentUrlPatterns, but lets you filter based on the src attribute of img/audio/video tags and the href of anchor tags.

title.description: The text to be displayed in the item; this is required unless type is separator. When the context is selection, you can use %s within the string to show the selected text. For example, if this parameter's value is Translate '%s' to Latin and the user selects the word cool, the context menu item for the selection is Translate 'cool' to Latin. To specify an access key for the new menu entry, include a & before the desired letter in the title. For example &Help.

type.description: The type of menu item. Defaults to <var>normal</var> if not specified.

viewTypes.description: List of view types where the menu item will be shown. Defaults to any view, including those without a viewType.

visible.description: Whether the item is visible in the menu.

parameters.description: Called when the item has been created in the browser. If there were any problems creating the item, details will be available in runtime.lastError.
parameters.name: callback

returns.description: The ID of the newly created item.

functions.description: Updates a previously created context menu item.
functions.name: update

parameters.description: The ID of the item to update.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: The properties to update. Accepts the same values as the create function.
parameters.name: updateProperties

parameters.description: The details of the tab where the click took place.
parameters.name: tab

parentId.description: The hierarchical parent of the element. Updating an element to become a child of its own descendants is not supported.

visible.description: Whether the item is visible in the menu.

parameters.description: Called when the context menu has been updated.
parameters.name: callback

parameters.description: The ID of the context menu item to remove.
parameters.name: menuItemId

parameters.description: Called when the context menu has been removed.
parameters.name: callback

functions.description: Removes all context menu items added by this extension.
functions.name: removeAll

functions.description: Show the matching menu items from this extension instead of the default menu. This should be called during a contextmenu event handler, and only applies to the menu that opens after this event.
functions.name: overrideContext

context.description: ContextType to override, to allow menu items from other extensions in the menu. Currently only <var>tab</var> is supported. <var>contextOptions.showDefaults</var> cannot be used with this option.

showDefaults.description: Whether to also include default menu items in the menu.

tabId.description: Required when context is <var>tab</var>. Requires the <permission>tabs</permission> permission.

functions.description: Updates the extension items in the shown menu, including changes that have been made since the menu was shown. Has no effect if the menu is hidden. Rebuilding a shown menu is an expensive operation, only invoke this method when necessary.
functions.name: refresh

ACTION_MENU_TOP_LEVEL_LIMIT.description: The maximum number of top level extension items that can be added to an extension action context menu. Any items beyond this limit will be ignored.

types.description: The different contexts a menu can appear in. Specifying all is equivalent to the combination of all other contexts excluding tab and tools_menu. More information about each context can be found in the Supported UI Elements article on developer.thunderbird.net.

types.description: Information sent when a context menu is being shown. Some properties are only included if the extension has host permission for the given context, for example <permission>activeTab</permission> for content tabs, <permission>compose</permission> for compose tabs and <permission>messagesRead</permission> for message display tabs.

attachments.description: The selected attachments. The <permission>compose</permission> permission is required to return attachments of a message being composed. The <permission>messagesRead</permission> permission is required to return attachments of displayed messages.

contexts.description: A list of all contexts that apply to the menu.

displayedFolder.description: The displayed folder. Only available for the <var>message_list</var> context. The <permission>accountsRead</permission> permission is required.

editable.description: A flag indicating whether the element is editable (text input, textarea, etc.).

fieldId.description: An identifier of the clicked Thunderbird UI element, if any.

annotations.text: The Bcc field of the message compose window.
The Cc field of the message compose window.
The Newsgroup field of the message compose window.
The Reply-To field of the message compose window.
The subject field of the message compose window.
The To field of the message compose window.

frameUrl.description: The URL of the frame of the element where the context menu was clicked, if it was in a frame.

linkText.description: If the element is a link, the text of that link.

linkUrl.description: If the element is a link, the URL it points to.

mediaType.description: One of <var>image</var>, <var>video</var>, or <var>audio</var> if the context menu was activated on one of these types of elements.

menuIds.description: A list of IDs of the menu items that were shown.

pageUrl.description: The URL of the page where the menu item was clicked. This property is not set if the click occurred in a context where there is no current page, such as in a launcher context menu.

selectedFolders.description: The selected folders in the folder pane. Only available for the <var>folder_pane</var> context. The <permission>accountsRead</permission> permission is required. The returned selection includes the folders which would be affected by a context action through Thunderbird's UI, which may not be the currently selected folders. For example, if the user has multiple folders selected and opens the context menu for a folder outside that selection, only the folder for which the context menu was opened, is returned.

selectedMessages.description: The selected message(s) in the message list (a.k.a. the thread pane). Only available for the <var>message_list</var> context. The <permission>messagesRead</permission> permission is required. The returned selection includes the messages which would be affected by a context action through Thunderbird's UI, which may not be the currently selected messages. For example, if the user has multiple messages selected and opens the context menu for a message outside that selection, only the message for which the context menu was opened, is returned.

selectionText.description: The text for the context selection, if any.

srcUrl.description: Will be present for elements with a src URL.

targetElementId.description: An identifier of the clicked content element, if any. Use $(ref:menus.getTargetElement) in the page to find the corresponding element.

viewType.description: The type of view where the menu is shown. May be unset if the menu is not associated with a view.

button.description: An integer value of button by which menu item was clicked.

checked.description: A flag indicating the state of a checkbox or radio item after it is clicked.

editable.description: A flag indicating whether the element is editable (text input, textarea, etc.).

fieldId.description: An identifier of the clicked Thunderbird UI element, if any.

parentMenuItemId.description: The parent ID, if any, for the item clicked.

The returned selection includes the folders which would be affected by a context action through Thunderbird's UI, which may not be the currently selected folders. For example, if the user has multiple folders selected and opens the context menu for a folder outside that selection, only the folder for which the context menu was opened, is returned.

The <permission>messagesRead</permission> permission is required. The returned selection includes the messages which would be affected by a context action through Thunderbird's UI, which may not be the currently selected messages. For example, if the user has multiple messages selected and opens the context menu for a message outside that selection, only the message for which the context menu was opened, is returned.

types.description: The path for a menu icon may be a relative path to an icon file, a <var>moz-extension:</var> URL, an image <var>data:</var> URL, a <var>blob:</var> URL, or a remote <var>http(s):</var> URL.

types.description: A dictionary object to specify paths for multiple icons in different sizes, so the best matching icon can be used, instead of scaling a standard icon to fit the pixel density of the user's display. Each entry is a name-value pair, with name being a size and value being a $(ref:menus.MenuIconPath).
